data.title: Release Celebration [The Floaty Messenger] Chartered Headhunting Details
data.brief: Dear Endministrator: During [The Floaty Messenger] Chartered Headhunting, 6★ operator [Gilberta] is
data.data:
Dear Endministrator:

During [The Floaty Messenger] Chartered Headhunting, 6★ operator [Gilberta] is Rate-UP!

The [Messenger Express] limited-time sign-in event will open simultaneously. Accumulate sign-ins to earn rewards such as [Messenger Express HH Permit]×5. You can also exchange for [Messenger Express HH Permit] at a discount in [AIC Quota Exchange]. The [Combat Drills] operator trial event will also be available during this period.


▼// [The Floaty Messenger] Chartered Headhunting Details

· Availability:

Americas / Europe: Feb. 7, 2026 at 12:00 – Feb. 24, 2026 at 11:59 (server time)

Asia: Feb. 7, 2026 at 12:00 – Feb. 24, 2026 at 11:59 (server time)

· Participation Criteria: Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process I: Break the Siege]

· [The Floaty Messenger] Chartered Headhunting features the Rate-UP 6★ operator [Gilberta].

· 6★ operators that may appear in [The Floaty Messenger] Chartered Headhunting include: Gilberta / Yvonne / Laevatain / Ember / Lifeng / Ardelia / Last Rite / Pogranichnik.

· In [The Floaty Messenger] Chartered Headhunting, you can use [Messenger Express HH Permit], [Messenger Express 10×Permit], [Chartered HH Permit] or [Oroberyls] to perform headhunting.

※ The Rate-UP 6★ operator featured in a [Chartered Headhunting] banner will be, after 3 [Chartered Headhunting] banners, removed from the list of operators that may appear in [Chartered Headhunting]. This Rate-UP 6★ operator will also not be added to [Basic Headhunting].


▼// [Chartered Headhunting] Rewards

In [The Floaty Messenger] Chartered Headhunting, perform a certain number of headhunting attempts to earn corresponding rewards.

■ Urgent Recruitment

· After performing 30 headhunting attempts, you will receive 10 bonus Urgent Recruitment attempts (which count as 1 free 10× headhunting attempt). This is only valid during this [Chartered Headhunting] banner, and does not carry over to other headhunting banners.

· The rates for obtaining operators through Urgent Recruitment are the same as the base drop rates of [Chartered Headhunting], and the free 10× headhunting attempt guarantees a 5★ or higher operator.

· This free 10× headhunting attempt given by Urgent Recruitment does not count toward the guarantee for this or other [Chartered Headhunting] banners. It also will not be added to the total headhunting attempts required for [Chartered Headhunting] rewards.

■ Headhunting Dossier

· After performing 60 headhunting attempts, you will receive a bonus [Headhunting Dossier]×1.

· Once the requirements are met, the [Headhunting Dossier] will be automatically sent to your Valuables Stash. Once the next [Chartered Headhunting] begins, this [Headhunting Dossier] will be automatically converted to a special 10×Permit of the said [Chartered Headhunting] banner. However, this 10×Permit will also expire once the said banner ends.

■ Token Tribute

· In each [Chartered Headhunting] banner, every 240 headhunting attempts give a bonus [Token of the Rate-UP 6★ operator featured in the said banner]×1.

▼// Arsenal Ticket Details

Every headhunting attempt for operators also gives [Arsenal Tickets].

· Acquiring a 6★ operator gives [Arsenal Ticket]×2000.

· Acquiring a 5★ operator gives [Arsenal Ticket]×200.

· Acquiring a 4★ operator gives [Arsenal Ticket]×20.

※ [Arsenal Tickets] can be spent at the [Acquisition Center - Arsenal Exchange].


During [The Floaty Messenger] Chartered Headhunting, the following content will also be available:

▼// [Messenger Express] Limited-Time Sign-In Event

Sign in for a total of 7 days to earn rewards such as [Messenger Express HH Permit]×5.

▼// [Combat Drills] Operator Trial Event

[Combat Drills] is available for trying out the 6★ operator [Gilberta]. Complete the specified stages with the preset team that includes the trial operator and go to the [Event Center] screen to claim the rewards.

▼// [AIC Quota Exchange] Special Note

The [Quota Exchange] will offer limited-time special deals. You can spend AIC Quota to purchase items such as [Messenger Express HH Permit]×5.


※ For more headhunting details, check the in-game [Headhunting] screen.

※ For more event details, check the in-game [Event Center].

※ For details on [AIC Quota Exchange], check the in-game [Acquisition Center].

※ Americas / Europe Time Zone: UTC-5

※ Asia Time Zone: UTC+8
